{{Quote|Great party, eh? These bugs have learned a lot about entertaining us mammals since the Clone Wars. Good wine. Good jatz. I could almost believe I was home in a Mos Eisley cantina, eh?|Anatta, to some of the other attendees of Duke Piddock's party|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''Anatta''' was a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who made a living as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]], and his services were regularly employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Anatta traveled to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and attended a party that was held by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]], where he hoped to learn some gossip that he could use to impress Jabba. During the event, Anatta encountered a band of fugitives that were on the run from the Hutt [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]], and he provided them with some information in return for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
